mentions.name: Lethe
mentions.description: This is an assistant agent (OpenClaw-like) with a human brain-inspired cognitive architecture, featuring episodic memory and elements modeled on the hippocampus, amygdala, and default mode network. It aims to feel like talking with an actual human assistant rather than a robot.
